text: For your eyes only: Hanne Lisberg told me Vantorre will cut to 240 seats at the June renewal. Ruth and Nadia do not know yet.
reply_text:

text: For the incident write-up: at what time did Gideon call both Hartford gate lanes working again on 3 Aug, and which trailer was the first check-in once kiosk 1 came back?
reply_text:
@Nadia Fennimore: Gideon's message says both Hartford gate lanes were working as of **11:07 AM** on 3 Aug. He posted that in the channel at 11:08. The first check-in after kiosk 1 came back was **trailer 8836**. Mateo Quiroga reported it at 11:03 AM ("Kiosk 1 is back. Guard checked in trailer 8836; dispatch sees it.").

The channel only has what was posted there, so any check-ins made on the gate that nobody mentioned aren't captured.
